product_goal: Ship a privacy-safe, deterministic CAD automation platform whose supported operations fail closed and remain independently verifiable.
global_rules: No language model may call a CAD API directly.
Unsupported or ambiguous geometry must fail closed.
Secrets, customer files, logs, and generated CAD outputs must not enter source control.

rules: A branch must support the current public-beta workstream.
A branch must be time-boxed and return to the mainline.
A completed branch requires evidence and passing tests.

phases.name: PartLoom 0.1.0 public beta
phases.objective: Harden installation, privacy, deterministic execution, and supported connector workflows.
exit_criteria: The release audit reports zero secrets, customer files, personal paths, logs, and output models.
Source tests and standalone launch smoke tests pass.
Installer and ZIP artifacts are reproducible.
